quests.title: Know the Keep
quests.description: Commander Vane does not give orders to people who cannot find the latrines. Walk the terraces - the lower court, the middle terrace and the graveyard wing - and report back. Do not touch anything that is not yours.
quests.accept_text: Three stops: the court inside the gate, the middle terrace, and the Raven Hill graveyard to the west.
quests.turn_in_text: You didn't fall off anything. That's a better start than most.

quests.title: The Woods Below
quests.description: The Keep sits above the pines, and the pines are full of worg and the leavings of the plague. Vane wants the approach to the gate kept short of anything with teeth.
quests.accept_text: In the woods south of the Keep, along the road you walked in on.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer teeth on the approach. I'll note it in the ledger.

quests.title: A Dispatch for the Rear Guard
quests.description: Vane has written to Captain Vesk of the Rear Guard. It is three lines long. He would like it delivered by someone who will not read it, and, failing that, someone who will not remember it.

objectives.label: Deliver Vane's dispatch to Captain Vesk at the Rear Guard

quests.accept_text: North along the road to the Rear Guard. Vesk is at the gate.
quests.turn_in_text: Three lines. Of course. It's rude, and exactly right.

on_accept.name: Vane's Dispatch
on_accept.description: A single sheet, folded thrice and sealed with the Keep's black wax.

quests.title: Shards of the Faithful
quests.description: Relic Hunter Darne pays for grave-goods, and the skeletal groundskeepers of Raven Hill carry the best of them: ring-shards, buckle-bone, whatever they were buried with. She wants six, intact.
quests.accept_text: From the groundskeepers at Raven Hill, to the south. Don't chip them.
quests.turn_in_text: These are good. Old and honest. The collectors in Undercity will weep.

quests.title: Marrow Work
quests.description: Yseult carves bone into combs, buttons and, occasionally, regret. Risen husks have the best marrow, she says, and they never complain about the harvest.
quests.accept_text: Risen husks, wherever the field is thickest. Six dry marrow-bones.
quests.turn_in_text: Dry and pale. I could carve a chapel out of these. I'll settle for a comb.

quests.title: Stings for the Apothecary
quests.description: Windfall wasps in Malden's Orchard are full of a venom Wrenn has been trying to buy for years. The orchard won't sell it. The wasps won't either. Wrenn would like it taken.
quests.accept_text: Malden's Orchard, north of the Raven Hill road. The stings are on the abdomen. Handle with tongs.
quests.turn_in_text: Six stings and no stinging. You have steadier hands than most.

quests.title: Names on the Stones
quests.description: Reader Cass reads the stones of the Raven Hill wing. Most are blank, rubbed smooth by rain and by something that rubs back. She wants three clusters visited and the weeds pulled away. 'Read them aloud,' she says. 'It helps.'
quests.accept_text: The graveyard wing, west of the middle terrace. Three clusters of stones.
quests.turn_in_text: Three more names. I'll write them on the wall, so they stay.

quests.title: Sleepers That Won't
quests.description: The tomb-keeper of the chapel yard counts sleepers each dusk. Some have stopped lying down. Groundskeepers and husks both wander from the Raven Hill plots in search of a bed that isn't theirs.
quests.accept_text: At Raven Hill, south of the Keep. Send them back where they belong.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer wanderers. I'll sleep better. Metaphorically.

quests.title: Crows at the Gate
quests.description: Crypt Guard Molsen is tired of the crows. They pick at the Keep's banners, steal buttons off his coat, and one of them has learned to open the gate-latch.
quests.accept_text: The Dead Field, east of the road. The harrowers feed them; thin both.
quests.turn_in_text: The latch-crow? Dead. Good. I owe you a drink I can't taste.

quests.title: The Hermit's Oil
quests.description: The Hermit has not left his lean-to since the Plague. His lamp is nearly dry. Spider-fat burns clean, he says, and he cannot hunt it himself, because spiders have opinions about hermits.
quests.accept_text: Silverpine spiders in the Skittering Dark. Five clean glands. Tell no one I asked.
quests.turn_in_text: I can read again. Not that there is much I wish to read.

quests.title: The Pilgrim's Road
quests.description: Osk walks between the Keep and Tirisfal every autumn, ostensibly to pray. He has no idea who he is praying to. He asks that the road between be made less murderous.
quests.accept_text: The woods north and east of the Keep. Spiders and treants, mainly.
quests.turn_in_text: A quieter road. I'll walk it once more before the snow.

quests.title: A Cracked Locket
quests.description: Taken from a skeletal groundskeeper's rib-cage: a cracked silver locket, with a single pressed flower inside. The one at the Keep who wanders the lower court without a name might know it.

objectives.label: Bring the locket to Something That Was Once Named in the lower court

quests.accept_text: The lower court of the Sepulcher. A figure who answers to nothing in particular.
quests.turn_in_text: ...yes. That one. Thank you. I think... I think I had a daughter.

quests.title: Wreaths for the Quiet
quests.description: The Mourner weaves wreaths from what the dead leave behind. Risen farmhands carry wilted sprays in their pockets - last year's offerings, never delivered. She wants six.
quests.accept_text: The farmhands of Olsen's Farthing, south of the Keep.
quests.turn_in_text: Even wilted, they mean something. I'll lay them where they were meant to go.
